notes.subject: מהומה ומבוסה ומבוכה
notes.rationale: triple near-rhyme (uproar/trampling/perplexity) built on the same m-b pattern; flattened in Bambara as three plain nouns.

notes.subject: מקרקר קיר ושוע
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV read 'breaking down the wall and crying'; JPS reads proper names 'Kir shouting, and Shoa at the mount'; rendered here with the majority wall-breaking sense.

notes.subject: גיא חזיון
notes.rationale: 'Valley of Vision' — a poetic name for Jerusalem, kept as the name Hizayon rather than translated.

notes.subject: to Jerusalem
notes.rationale: the Valley-of-Vision oracle addresses Jerusalem obliquely; no direct addressee named in this verse.

translation: Sabu don min ye Yawe, Adonay, Tsevawot ka don ye — yɛlɛma don, ɲɔgɔnboli don, manyen don — Hizayon kuluja kɔnɔ: biri-tigɛli don, ani kuma don min bɛ taa kulu kan.
